title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass
summary: The powerful Spyglass tool is now officially launched, bringing an even more refined experience and advanced capabilities to all users.

title: Take Control of Your Files
summary: Effortlessly manage your embedded files and customize their visual presentation within the editor, giving you unprecedented control over your content.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap!
summary: Explore our dynamic new public roadmap to see recently shipped features, exciting upcoming releases, and future plans, keeping you informed every step of the way.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and efficient task management experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to drag, and beautifully aligned with our modern user interface.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: We've elevated your team's ability to work together seamlessly with clearer real-time updates and improved syncing indicators.

title: Effortless Collaboration with Shared Items
summary: Enjoy enhanced search capabilities and improved visibility of shared items, making collaboration with others smoother than ever.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive international language support.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Constellation
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflows by exploring your knowledge base with powerful new filtering capabilities for tags, time, and shared content in the Constellation view.

title: Precision Search and Personalized Collections
summary: Unleash the full potential of your knowledge base by leveraging new advanced search filters, custom sorting, and the ability to save your precise searches for quick retrieval.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Experience a more dynamic and intuitive way to organize your thoughts with enhanced views and interactive options for your linked content.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Prepare to elevate your experience as we launch Noeko with new self-hosting capabilities and a range of premium plans tailored to your needs.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Refreshes
summary: We're enhancing your visual experience with beautifully refined existing themes and an exciting collection of brand new options.

title: Smart Time Greetings
summary: Experience a more personalized welcome as we refine our time-based greetings to always accurately reflect the current time of day.

title: Streamlined Bulk Actions for Tags
summary: Gain greater control over your content by quickly removing items from tags and performing other essential actions directly within your tag views.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: We're excited to announce that you will soon be able to effortlessly import and interact with information from a wider array of sources, including websites, YouTube videos, and text files, making your knowledge hub more comprehensive than ever.
